# NavigationItem

Reusable navigation row/item primitive for top navigation, side navigation, and compact rails.

- **Import:** `import { NavigationItem } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Navigation
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/navigation-navigationitem--docs>

## Example

From its `Side` story.

```tsx
import {
  Bell01 as Bell,
  ChevronRight,
  Home01 as Home,
  SearchMd as Search,
  Settings01 as Settings,
} from "@kozmos-ds/icons";
import { NavigationItem, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function NavigationItemExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <nav className="flex w-64 flex-col gap-1 rounded-control border bg-background p-3">
        <NavigationItem icon={<Home className="h-5 w-5" />} selected>
          Overview
        </NavigationItem>
        <NavigationItem icon={<Search className="h-5 w-5" />}>
          Explore
        </NavigationItem>
        <NavigationItem
          badge="3"
          content="badge"
          icon={<Bell className="h-5 w-5" />}
        >
          Notifications
        </NavigationItem>
        <NavigationItem
          content="trailing"
          icon={<Settings className="h-5 w-5" />}
          trailing={<ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />}
        >
          Settings
        </NavigationItem>
      </nav>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## NavigationItem

It forwards its ref to `HTMLElement`. Its props are `NavigationItemProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "children">, Omit<VariantProps<typeof navigationItemVariants>, "state">`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.
- `badge`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `children`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `content`: `NavigationItemContent`, optional.
- `density`: `VariantProps<typeof navigationItemVariants>["density"]`, optional, default `"default"`.

  How roomy a top or side item is. A rail item has one size and draws the
  same with `compact` as without it: the 64px compact tile is retired, and
  a rail item fills its rail (decision 42).

- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.
- `focusVisible`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.
- `href`: `string`, optional.
- `icon`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `label`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `selected`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.
- `state`: `NavigationItemState`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `trailing`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `placement`: `"top" | "side" | "rail" | null`, optional, default `"side"`.

It also takes the 262 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### NavigationItemContent

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type NavigationItemContent =
  | "label"
  | "icon-label"
  | "icon-only"
  | "badge"
  | "trailing";
```

### NavigationItemState

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type NavigationItemState =
  | "default"
  | "hover"
  | "selected"
  | "focus"
  | "disabled";
```
